Why education?

Because it is inspiring growth

Choosing a path in education felt like an easy choice for me. I wanted to contribute to the field that should be expanding and
nurturing potential. No matter what we study, and decide to teach, it should expand the view on what we grasped previously.
Because of that my choice has led me to be motivated towards the path of understanding and new posibilities.


To me, education is not just about teaching; it is about inspiring growth, nurturing potential, and making a lasting difference in
people's lives.

Because of that my choice has led me to be motivated towards the path of understanding and new posibilities.

To me, education is not just about teaching; it is about inspiring growth, nurturing potential, and making a lasting difference in people's lives.

All of the projects and topics I have researched and studied during my double bachelor and master’s program of

Philosophy and Language and Literature of Croatian Language

have developed me into the humanities interdisciplinarian.


Topic that were applied and shaped my knowledge are various: Pedagogy, Didactics, World Literature, Children Literature, Syntax,
Semantics, Metaphysics, Philosophy of Science, Logic...


And all of them were structured into tree different fields: Philosophy, Literature and Linguistics.


Rooting from such structure, my highlights of studies and work in education will be shown further.

Projects and seminars

title : “Creative Approach in the Literature Teaching”

Writing and researching about what creativity brings to the understanding of literature, which methods can be brought in praxis to enlarge the methodical system of learning about literature and how creativity can be encouraged in the studies of literature. Systems researched: interpretive-analytical system, problem solving-creative system, correlation-integration system, communication system, multimedia, team system.


Published in: Education; Magazine for Pedagogical Theory and Practice (Vaspitanje i obrazovanje, časopis za pedagošku teoriju i praksu), Podgorica, Crna Gora.

Projects and seminars

title : “Philosophy in a Fairytale and
Fairytale in a Philosophy in the Example of
the Fairytale Le Petit Prince”

Symposium oral presentation, opened the dialog about literature and its philosophical interpretation of Le Petit Prince by Antoine de Saint Exhupery, focused on a reader and their capacity to understand a fairytale through retrieving childlike perception.


Published in: Philosophy in Literature, Sixth Student Philosophical Symposium journal (Filozofija u književnosti, 6. studentski filozofski simpozij), Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences, Josip Juraj Strossmayer University of Osijek.


Peer review can be seen here: Philosophical Life

title : “Artificial Intelligence in the
Framework of Transhumanism and
Bioethics”

A research experience aimed to define what artificial intelligence is, and its relations to bioethical questions of transhumanism. My work encompassed questions of human responsibility to life on Earth and the ethical ways of maintaining that responsibility, while engaging with AI directly through the human body.

title : “Epistemological Frames of the
Calculation of Probability”

The paper Epistemological Frames of the Calculation of Probability focuses on the mathematical-philosophic problem of adopting the Theory of the Calculation of Probability. The theory passes through different “stages” and theory frameworks included in other scientific fields besides Philosophy, and encounters multiple inequalities.


Published in: Repository of Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences Osijek

Further development

I aspire to contribute my knowledge to the interdisciplinary humanities while continuing to learn, grow, and gain new perspectives through teaching and the exchange of ideas.

Education is not a one-way process of sharing knowledge, but a continuous exchange in which both teaching and learning contribute to intellectual growth.
